title: Smoky Mackerel Tikka Masala
description: A twist on the classic Indian dish, Smoky Mackerel Tikka Masala incorporates the bold flavors of Uruguayan mackerel into a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together curry powder, cumin, and paprika.
3. Rub the spice blend onto both sides of the mackerel fillets.
4. Bake the mackerel in the oven for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
5. While the mackerel is baking, heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
6. Add the ginger paste and garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes.
7. Add the tomato puree and heavy cream, stir to combine.
8. Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until thickened.
9. Once the mackerel is done, add it to the sauce and stir to coat.
10. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
11. Serve the Smoky Mackerel Tikka Masala hot over basmati rice or with naan bread.
